# ductus

> Gauge which parts of a text read as machine-written, and why, with the evidence anchored to exact characters

- [ductus.score](_autosummary/ductus.score.html.md): Turning evidence into a lean – the `aggregate=` seam.
- [ductus.segment](_autosummary/ductus.segment.html.md): Cutting a text into the units that get scored – the `segmenter=` seam.
- [ductus.tells](_autosummary/ductus.tells.html.md): The tells catalogue: named regular-expression patterns, tiered by confidence.
